ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓمٓ
en: (1) Alif, Lām, Meem.[1170]
tr: Alif lām mīm

ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (2) [This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds.
tr: Tanzīlul-kitābi lā rayba fīhi mir rabbil-ʿālamīn

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
en: (3) Or do they say, "He invented it"? Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, [O Muḥammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided.
tr: Am yaqūlūnaftarāh, bal huwal-ḥaqqu mir rabbika litundhira qawmam mā atāhum min nadhīrim min qablika laʿallahum yahtadūn

ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
en: (4) It is Allāh who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then He established Himself above the Throne.[1171] You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded?
tr: Allāhul-ladhī khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin thummastawā ʿalal-ʿarsh, mā lakum min dūnihī miw waliyyiw walā shafīʿ, afalā tatadhakkarūn

ar: يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥٓ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
en: (5) He arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count.
tr: Yudabbirul-amra minas-samāʾi ilal-arḍi thumma yaʿruju ilayhi fī yawmin kāna miqdāruhū alfa sanatim mimmā taʿuddūn

ar: ذَٰلِكَ عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
en: (6) That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
tr: Dhālika ʿālimul-ghaybi wash-shahādatil-ʿazīzur-raḥīm

ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ مِن طِينٍ
en: (7) Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.
tr: Al-ladhī aḥsana kulla shayʾin khalaqahū wabadaʾa khalqal-insāni min ṭīn

ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُۥ مِن سُلَٰلَةٍ مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
en: (8) Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained.
tr: Thumma jaʿala naslahū min sulālatim mim māʾim mahīn

ar: ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
en: (9) Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His [created] soul[1172] and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.
enNotes: [1172]- i.e., element of life. See footnote to 15:29.
tr: Thumma sawwāhu wanafakha fīhi mir rūḥihī wajaʿala lakumus-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afʾidah, qalīlam mā tashkurūn

ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَءِنَّا لَفِى خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍۭ بَلْ هُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
en: (10) And they say, "When we are lost [i.e., disintegrated] within the earth, will we indeed be [recreated] in a new creation?" Rather, they are, in the meeting with their Lord, disbelievers.
tr: Waqālū aʾidhā ḍalalnā fil-arḍi aʾinnā lafī khalqin jadīd, bal hum biliqāʾi rabbihim kāfirūn

ar: قُلْ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم مَّلَكُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ٱلَّذِى وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ
en: (11) Say, "The angel of death who has been entrusted with you will take you. Then to your Lord you will be returned."
tr: Qul yatawaffākum malakul-mawtil-ladhī wukkila bikum thumma ilā rabbikum turjaʿūn

ar: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُوا۟ رُءُوسِهِمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَآ أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَٱرْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ
en: (12) If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness. Indeed, we are [now] certain."
tr: Walaw tarā idhil-mujrimūna nākisū ruʾūsihim ʿinda rabbihim, rabbanā abṣarnā wasamiʿnā farjiʿnā naʿmal ṣāliḥan innā mūqinūn

ar: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَـَٔاتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَىٰهَا وَلَٰكِنْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنِّى لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: (13) And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word[1173] from Me will come into effect [that] "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together.
tr: Walaw shiʾnā laʾātaynā kulla nafsin hudāhā walākin ḥaqqal-qawlu minnī laʾamlaʾanna jahannama minal-jinnati wan-nāsi ajmaʿīn

ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَآ إِنَّا نَسِينَٰكُمْ وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (14) So taste [punishment] because you forgot the meeting of this, your Day; indeed, We have [accordingly] forgotten you. And taste the punishment of eternity for what you used to do."
tr: Fadhūqū bimā nasītum liqāʾa yawmikum hādhā, innā nasīnākum wadhūqū ʿadhābal-khuldi bimā kuntum taʿmalūn

ar: إِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهَا خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَسَبَّحُوا۟ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
en: (15) Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant.
tr: Innamā yuʾminu biʾāyātinal-ladhīna idhā dhukkirū bihā kharrū sujjadaw wasabbaḥū biḥamdi rabbihim wahum lā yastakbirūn

ar: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
en: (16) Their sides part [i.e., they arise] from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.[1174]
tr: Tatajāfā junūbuhum ʿanil-maḍājiʿi yadʿūna rabbahum khawfaw waṭamaʿā, wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn

ar: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أُخْفِىَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (17) And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes [i.e., satisfaction] as reward for what they used to do.
tr: Falā taʿlamu nafsum mā ukhfiya lahum min qurrati aʿyun, jazāʾam bimā kānū yaʿmalūn

ar: أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقًا لَّا يَسْتَوُۥنَ
en: (18) Then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? They are not equal.
tr: Afaman kāna muʾminan kaman kāna fāsiqā, lā yastawūn

ar: أَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ نُزُلًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (19) As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the Gardens of Refuge as accommodation for what they used to do.
tr: Ammal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti falahum jannātul-maʾwā, nuzulam bimā kānū yaʿmalūn

ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فَسَقُوا۟ فَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَآ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
en: (20) But as for those who defiantly disobeyed, their refuge is the Fire. Every time they wish to emerge from it, they will be returned to it while it is said to them, "Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny."
tr: Waʾammal-ladhīna fasaqū famaʾwāhumun-nāru kullamā arādū ay yakhrujū minhā uʿīdū fīhā waqīla lahum dhūqū ʿadhāban-nāril-ladhī kuntum bihī tukadhdhibūn

ar: وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَدْنَىٰ دُونَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
en: (21) And We will surely let them taste the nearer punishment[1175] short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will return [i.e., repent].
enNotes: [1175]- i.e., the disasters and calamities of this world.
tr: Walanudhīqannahum minal-ʿadhābil-adnā dūnal-ʿadhābil-akbari laʿallahum yarjiʿūn

ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهَآ إِنَّا مِنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ مُنتَقِمُونَ
en: (22) And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord; then he turns away from them? Indeed We, from the criminals, will take retribution.
tr: Waman aẓlamu mimman dhukkira biʾāyāti rabbihī thumma aʿraḍa ʿanhā, innā minal-mujrimīna muntaqimūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ فَلَا تَكُن فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَآئِهِۦ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
en: (23) And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting.[1176] And We made it [i.e., the Torah] guidance for the Children of Israel.
enNotes: [1176]- i.e., Muḥammad's meeting Moses on the night of al-Miʿrāj (ascent).
tr: Walaqad ātaynā mūsal-kitāba falā takun fī miryatim mil liqāʾihī wajaʿalnāhu hudal libanī isrāʾīl

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ
en: (24) And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs.
tr: Wajaʿalnā minhum aʾimmatay yahdūna biʾamrinā lammā ṣabarū, wakānū biʾāyātinā yūqinūn

ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
en: (25) Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
tr: Inna rabbaka huwa yafṣilu baynahum yawmal-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَٰكِنِهِمْ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ أَفَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ
en: (26) Has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, [as] they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs; then do they not hear?
tr: Awalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknā min qablihim minal-qurūni yamshūna fī masākinihim, inna fī dhālika laʾāyāt, afalā yasmaʿūn

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا نَسُوقُ ٱلْمَآءَ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَٰمُهُمْ وَأَنفُسُهُمْ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ
en: (27) Have they not seen that We drive water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves? Then do they not see?
tr: Awalam yaraw annā nasūqul-māʾa ilal-arḍil-juruzi fanukhriju bihī zarʿan taʾkulu minhu anʿāmuhum waʾanfusuhum, afalā yubṣirūn

ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْفَتْحُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: (28) And they say, "When will be this conquest,[1177] if you should be truthful?"
tr: Wayaqūlūna matā hādhal-fatḥu in kuntum ṣādiqīn

ar: قُلْ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَتْحِ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
en: (29) Say, [O Muḥammad], "On the Day of Conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved."
tr: Qul yawmal-fatḥi lā yanfaʿul-ladhīna kafarū īmānuhum walā hum yunẓarūn

ar: فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَٱنتَظِرْ إِنَّهُم مُّنتَظِرُونَ
en: (30) So turn away from them and wait. Indeed, they are waiting.
tr: Faʾaʿriḍ ʿanhum wantaẓir innahum muntaẓirūn
